description: Damn Vulnerable NodeJS Application (Node.js/Express, Sequelize): every flaw that its solution guide (docs/solution/*.md) describes and that has a location in the source, labelled at that location. Held out: no rule may be written against it.

vulnerabilities.description: userSearch concatenates req.body.login into a raw SQL string and runs it with sequelize.query (SQL injection).
ping passes 'ping -c 2 ' + req.body.address to child_process.exec (OS command injection).
resetPw accepts a reset token that is md5(login), which anyone can compute, so any user's password can be reset.
resetPwSubmit checks the same predictable md5(login) token before setting the new password.
vulnerabilities.note: docs/solution/a2-broken-auth.md (Insecure Reset Password); fix commit c8d519e changes this check too

vulnerabilities.description: The express-session secret is the well-known example string 'keyboard cat', so session cookies can be forged.
listUsersAPI returns whole User rows, password hashes included, to the browser.
The Sequelize connection keeps default query logging, so every query (with its values) goes to console.log.
bulkProducts parses an uploaded XML file with libxmljs and noent:true, which expands external entities (XXE).
The /admin/usersapi route only checks that the caller is logged in, not that they are an admin; the admin check is client-side in admin.ejs.
userEditSubmit loads the user to edit by req.body.id without checking it is the caller, so anyone can change another user's password, email and name (IDOR).
vulnerabilities.note: docs/solution/a5-broken-access-control.md (Missing Authorization check in Edit User)

vulnerabilities.description: calc passes req.body.eqn to mathjs.eval with no error handling, so a bad equation returns a stack trace.
The Express app is created without app.disable('x-powered-by'), so every response advertises Express.
The product search term is rendered with the unescaped EJS tag <%- (reflected XSS).
Product name is rendered with <%- (stored XSS).
Product code is rendered with <%- (stored XSS).
Product tags are rendered with <%- (stored XSS).
Product description is rendered with <%- (stored XSS).
vulnerabilities.note: docs/solution/a7-xss.md (Stored XSS in Product Listing); fix commit 6acbb14 escapes this cell too

vulnerabilities.description: The users page writes users[i].name into the DOM with innerHTML (DOM XSS).
The users page writes users[i].email into the DOM with innerHTML (DOM XSS).
bulkProductsLegacy passes the uploaded file to node-serialize's unserialize, which runs embedded functions (RCE).
The add/edit product form has no anti-CSRF token and the POST handler checks none.
The edit user form has no anti-CSRF token and the POST handler checks none.
redirect sends the user to req.query.url without validation (open redirect).
